title: HVDC link (asset overlay)
description: Phase 5a asset overlay kind. An HVDC link described over the authored converter generators (the converters stay authored as converter-interfaced generators). Carried beside the model, never used by the solver.

dcVoltageKv.description: Rated DC voltage (pole to earth), kV.

cableLengthKm.description: DC cable or line length, kilometres.

sendingConverter.description: The authored converter generator at this end of the link.

receivingConverter.description: The authored converter generator at the far end (absent when the far end is outside the case).
